last.verdict: Investors sold BofA on a trading miss and a $1.2 billion regulatory penalty.

reasons.label: $1.2B regulatory penalty
reasons.text: A $1.2 billion charge for anti-money-laundering failures cut EPS to $0.91 from about $1.08.

reasons.label: Weak bond trading
reasons.text: Fixed-income trading fell 17% to $2.5 billion, roughly $450 million below analyst estimates.

reasons.label: Profit miss
reasons.text: Adjusted EPS of $1.08 missed the $1.10 expected, with lower advisory and debt deal fees.

story: Earlier quarters beat estimates, but the stock still slipped: down about 2% premarket in January on weak deal fees, and pressured in July near its highs. Interest income guidance kept rising. Shares were already down 16% from August's high before this report.
